name: Supreme Power Equipment Ltd
tagline: Debt-free small-cap transformer manufacturer (power/generator/windmill transformers) riding the grid-capex and renewables tailwind with 30%+ revenue CAGR, but in a crowded, commoditized transformer-maker field with no clear differentiated moat.
business_overview: Incorporated 1994, Supreme Power Equipment manufactures, upgrades and renovates power transformers, generator transformers and windmill/wind-turbine transformers, serving India's power-sector capex and renewables buildout. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@rdkriplani, bullish, medium conviction, 2026-09-13).

fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely strong growth (30%+ revenue CAGR) and clean balance sheet (near-zero debt, ROCE/ROE both ~20%+), riding real power-sector and renewables transformer demand. However the transformer-manufacturing space in India is crowded with many small/mid-cap listed peers (Shilchar, TARIL, Voltamp, Raychem RPG, Danish Power) competing on similar order-book/utilization dynamics, so differentiated moat is unclear at this stage. P/E ~26x is not obviously cheap for the growth, but not stretched either given the CAGR.
